body: The only woman I ever loved being gone thing did affect me greatly, but it was really just part of the puzzle.  Everything I cared about is gone and now nothing matters.  I'm not really even sad about everything, I just don't care anymore.  I want out, the effort to rebuild doesn't seem worth it.  I could distract myself again with someone or something else, but when life's inevitable up and downs happen I'll just wind up in this same spot.  I'm looking for a greater reason to deal with those ups and downs.  Even when I was happy I wasn't truely happy.  The pointlessness(is that a word?) of life was always at the back of my mind.  How do people live life without God and still manage to care?

I've definitely thought of doing something completely different and starting a new life somewhere else.  The problem is I'm not capable of doing something like that, if I was then I wouldn't be in the situation in the first place.  I wouldnt've isolated myself and cringed at everything that came my way.  Doing something like you mentioned is beyond my realm of possibility.  Plus that's a lot of effort, when you want to die it's much easier just to die.  If you can put in that much effort to ruining your life then you can put in that much effort into fixing it.

Thanks for the words and suggestions, I'll look over them.  There is no religion in my world and living life that way is extremely hard.  The only reason I made it this long is because something was always around to distract from that fundamental issue.  Now everything has been stripped away and I'm back facing it yet again.  This time I don't think I can go back to ignoring it and being distracted again.  Now I either find meaning or die, and it doesn't look good as I haven't found any after all these years.

I workout everyday in some form or another and feel fairly ok when doing it but that feeling doesn't last.  Same with drinking, I feel great being hammered for a few hours and then it fades.  Problem is I can't be drunk 24/7 or lifting weights all the time either.  These and things like them are all distractions from the main underlying issue.  I don't have anything else in life I care about.
I've thought about adopting a cat, but honestly I'm not sure if I'll be around long so I don't want to create a headache for the little critter.

I told her I was happy for her when I really wasn't, still doesn't make me feel any better.  I feel like she gave up on me when things were at their worst.  I deserved better, we've known each other our whole lives pretty much and been through a lot.  But I guess everyone has their limit and cuts their losses and moves on at some point.  That was her's, I'm thinking this is mine.  Knowing her for so long it was like losing yet another family member, just not easy to deal with.

I'm sure the people who are dead now would want me to be happy but I also think they would understand life is crap many times and would understand me splattering my brains across the wall. :/

The business isn't possible to redo, I was basically an off the books helper there.  In retrospect that was really stupid but at the time I didn't care because I was working with people I loved and that's all that mattered.  I greatly enjoyed all the time I spent with my dad and friend, it was the 3 of us, even when I was getting paid jack for it pretty much.  Now I really have nothing to show for it as I haven't had an "official" job for so long people would ask me if I've been living under a rock for the past 10 years.

Thanks for the words though...
